title: Ferric
subtitle: Iron, barbs, certainty
text: Ferric keeps the same name in both common and alchemical records. It is solidity, iron, barbs, and unchanging resolve. Blood drawn through mineral certainty remembers the permanence of stone and tries to impose that permanence on everything it touches. Ferric-tended Hemomancers are often described as immovable, not slow but absolute. Their blood has decided. It does not reconsider.
